title: Cookie policy
intro: A short page, because there is little to report. This site sets no tracking cookies and runs no analytics.

children.text: This site runs no analytics, no advertising pixels and no third-party tracking scripts. There is no consent banner because there is nothing to consent to.
If that changes, this page changes first, and a genuine consent mechanism is added that blocks the scripts until you accept, with rejecting exactly as easy as accepting.

sections.heading: What is stored on your device

children.text: The eligibility check saves your answers in your browser's local storage so that you can leave and come back without starting again. That data stays on your device and is cleared when you submit. It is not a cookie and it is not sent anywhere until you submit the form.
A dismissal of the preview notice is stored for the length of your browsing session so it does not reappear on every page.
Both are strictly necessary for the feature you are using, and neither identifies you. Clearing your browser data removes them.

sections.heading: Things we deliberately did not embed

children.text: We use a static map image rather than a live map embed, and a plain form rather than a third-party scheduling widget. Both alternatives would have set third-party cookies and slowed the site on a mid-range phone, for no benefit to you.
If you want to know exactly what this site stores in your browser, ask us through the contact page and we will tell you plainly.
